entities.name: Jakub Jan Susza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jakiv Ivan Susha - was the Bishop of Chełm–Belz in the Ruthenian Uniate Church from 1652 to 1687. He was also the Protoarchimandrite of the Order of Saint Basil the Great (1661-1666).
